eval: (() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; window.__dwCheck = (name, ok, detail) => { if (!ok) console.error(`[weather check] ${name} failed: ${detail}`); return `${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name}: ${detail}`; }; window.__dwWeatherEvents = []; game.ctx.bus.onTyped('weatherChanged', (event) => window.__dwWeatherEvents.push(event)); return 'listening for weatherChanged'; })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const weather = game.ctx.systems.weather.getState(); const sky = game.ctx.systems.sky.getModifierState(); return window.__dwCheck('opening is clear with the sky untouched', weather.state === 'clear' && weather.skyStorminess === 0 && weather.skyGolden === 0 && sky.active === false && sky.ids.includes('weather'), JSON.stringify({ weather: weather.state, bucket: weather.bucket, region: weather.region, skyActive: sky.active, modifiers: sky.ids })); })()

(() => { const sky = window.DRIFTWING.ctx.systems.sky; const baseline = sky.getModifierState().count; const probe = sky.addModifier('probe', { priority: 50 }); probe.set({ darkness: 0.5, stars: 0.4, weight: 0.5, skyTint: 0x336699, skyTintAmount: 1 }); sky.update(0, 0); const state = sky.getModifierState(); probe.remove(); sky.update(0, 0); const after = sky.getModifierState(); let duplicate = false; const again = sky.addModifier('probe2'); try { sky.addModifier('probe2'); } catch (error) { duplicate = true; } again.remove(); return window.__dwCheck('sky modifier blend and removal', Math.abs(state.darkness - 0.25) < 1e-9 && Math.abs(state.stars - 0.2) < 1e-9 && Math.abs(state.skyTintAmount - 0.5) < 1e-9 && state.active && !after.active && after.count === baseline && duplicate, JSON.stringify({ darkness: state.darkness, stars: state.stars, tint: state.skyTintAmount, afterActive: after.active, count: baseline + ' -> ' + after.count, duplicateRefused: duplicate })); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const sky = game.ctx.systems.sky.getModifierState(); const fog = game.ctx.scene.fog; return window.__dwCheck('storm darkens and closes the fog', sky.active && sky.darkness > 0.25 && sky.fogDensity > 2.5 && sky.overcast > 0.85, JSON.stringify({ sky, fogNear: Math.round(fog.near), fogFar: Math.round(fog.far), sunIntensity: game.ctx.systems.sky.sunLight.intensity })); })()

(() => { const sky = window.DRIFTWING.ctx.systems.sky.getModifierState(); return window.__dwCheck('clearing turns golden', sky.active && sky.sunIntensity > 1 && sky.skyTintAmount > 0.3, JSON.stringify(sky)); })()
(() => { window.DRIFTWING.ctx.systems.weather.forceState(null); return 'weather handed back to the model'; })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const events = window.__dwWeatherEvents; const states = events.map((event) => event.state).join(' > '); const weather = game.ctx.systems.weather.getState(); return window.__dwCheck('weatherChanged events', events.length === 4 && states === 'building > storm > clearing > clear' && events.every((event) => typeof event.region === 'string' && event.region.length > 0), `${states} region ${weather.region}`); })()
